#### 8a. `Logs_suppressed` context manager in `borgmatic/logger.py`
[`borgmatic/logger.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/borgmatic/logger.py?L388-424) lines 388–424: `Logs_suppressed` is a general-purpose context manager for attribute-keyed log filtering. Its immediate use in `repo_create.py` (fix for `eb5c9e6`) is a bug fix, but the abstraction itself — accepting arbitrary `**filter_attributes` — is clearly reusable infrastructure. Similarly `Log_exclude_filter` / `add_log_exclude_filter` / `remove_log_exclude_filter` (lines 342–385) form the scaffolding layer.

#### 8b. `borgmatic/hooks/credential/` subsystem
The credential directory with `parse.py` (the `resolve_credential` dispatcher) and four backends (`file`, `keepassxc`, `systemd`, `container`) is a plugin-shaped dispatch architecture. The `{credential ...}` syntax is consumed across monitoring hooks (Apprise), passphrase handling, and potentially any future hook. This is architectural scaffolding for credential management extensibility.

#### 8c. Signal-based threading model in `browse`
[`borgmatic/actions/browse/workers.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/borgmatic/actions/browse/workers.py?L107-139) defines `Archive_path_loaded` with an internal `path_hierarchy` dict and `complete` flag — a stateful signal that lets newly created widgets "catch up" on already-published events. This is not standard Textual signal usage; it is scaffolding for the lazy-loading concurrency model of the browse UI.

- `2a026a4` — "Stop using Ruff 'preview' rules, as CI has an older version of Ruff." (`pyproject.toml` line 60: `preview = false`.)

## Taxonomy Summary

| Task Shape | Instances at Cutoff | Key Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Feature** | 5 discrete features | `browse` TUI action; `archive_hostname`/`archive_username`; `--quick-stats` on prune; MariaDB dump options; credential subsystem |
| **Localized Bug Fix** | ~11 targeted fixes | `compact` threshold=0; `compact --progress`; `diff` exclude options; `repo-create` log suppression; ZFS unmount path; `restore` port matching; browse race conditions |
| **Refactor** | 4 | `panels.py` split; function merge; cross-thread → signals; `normalize_commands` extraction |
| **Test Generation** | ~10 commits | Browse test burst driven by 100% coverage enforcement |
| **Dependency Migration** | 2 | Textual/binaryornot adoption (feature-coupled); routine dependency bump |
| **Documentation / Configuration** | ~7 commits | Docs, NEWS, sample systemd service, schema example correction |
| **Boilerplate** | Multiple `__init__.py` | Package markers accompanying feature work |
| **Architectural Scaffolding** | 3 | `Logs_suppressed` infrastructure; credential dispatch plugin system; stateful Textual signal model |
| **Cleanup** | 3 | System command removal; Ruff config; NEWS reorder |

---

## Taxonomy Refinement Proposal

The existing eight categories cover all observed work. One refinement is warranted:

**`feature-coupled dependency migration`** should be distinguished from **`maintenance dependency migration`**. In this codebase, Textual adoption is inseparable from the `browse` feature — the dependency and the feature were introduced together. Treating it as a standalone "dependency migration" obscures that the task shape is actually a feature with a dependency side-effect. The proposed frozen refinement:

> Split **dependency migration** into:
> - `dependency migration (maintenance)` — version bumps and in-place library swaps in existing code (e.g., `b1f42eb`)
> - `dependency migration (feature-coupled)` — new library adoption that only exists to support a simultaneously introduced feature (e.g., Textual for `browse`); should be co-labeled with its parent feature task

No new top-level category is required.

Commit `ac65e65` ("Merge get_archive_path() into get_archive_paths()") — function consolidation eliminating a separate singular getter.

#### 3c. Cross-thread call replacement with signals
Commit `64ceebb` ("Replace cross-thread calls with signals") — replaced direct cross-thread method calls with `textual.signal.Signal`-based pub/sub (evident in [`workers.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/borgmatic/actions/browse/workers.py?L15-45): `Archive_loaded`, `Archive_path_loaded`, `File_preview_loaded`). ### 4. Test Generation

**Definition used:** Commits whose primary content is adding or completing test coverage, with minimal production code change.

Evident from the `browse-action` branch integration sequence:

- `ec8e529` — "More tests!"

The project enforces 100% coverage (`--cov-fail-under=100` in `pyproject.toml` line 50), which directly drives these test-generation bursts.

**Ambiguity note:** Several commits (`e82c1bb`, `174aa3d`) combine test generation with minor bug fixes or refactors. They are best labeled **test generation + localized bug fix** (compound task).

### 5. Dependency Migration

**Definition used:** Adoption of a new library or update of an existing one, with corresponding code adaptation.

#### 5a. Textual adoption for `browse` UI
[`pyproject.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/pyproject.toml?L34-35) lines 34–35 add `textual` and `binaryornot` as optional extras. [`borgmatic/actions/browse/app.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/borgmatic/actions/browse/app.py?L1-9) imports `textual.app`, `textual.binding`, `textual.widgets`. Commit `6020154` ("Add Textual to stand-alone binary to support the browse action"). Commit `13031a4` ("Upgrade/add test requirements").

**Definition used:** Structural file stubs, `__init__.py` files, empty modules needed for package recognition.

- [`borgmatic/actions/browse/__init__.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/borgmatic/actions/browse/__init__.py) — empty, package marker.

### 8. Architectural Scaffolding

**Definition used:** Infrastructure enabling a class of future work, not itself a complete feature.

#### 8a. `Logs_suppressed` context manager in `borgmatic/logger.py`
[`borgmatic/logger.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/borgmatic/logger.py?L388-424) lines 388–424: `Logs_suppressed` is a general-purpose context manager for attribute-keyed log filtering. Its immediate use in `repo_create.py` (fix for `eb5c9e6`) is a bug fix, but the abstraction itself — accepting arbitrary `**filter_attributes` — is clearly reusable infrastructure. Similarly `Log_exclude_filter` / `add_log_exclude_filter` / `remove_log_exclude_filter` (lines 342–385) form the scaffolding layer.

#### 8b. `borgmatic/hooks/credential/` subsystem
The credential directory with `parse.py` (the `resolve_credential` dispatcher) and four backends (`file`, `keepassxc`, `systemd`, `container`) is a plugin-shaped dispatch architecture. The `{credential ...}` syntax is consumed across monitoring hooks (Apprise), passphrase handling, and potentially any future hook. This is architectural scaffolding for credential management extensibility.

#### 8c. Signal-based threading model in `browse`
[`borgmatic/actions/browse/workers.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/borgmatic-collective-borgmatic@dbc3fc356ce58a1a8a37422b387ca22f7b3a651b/-/blob/borgmatic/actions/browse/workers.py?L107-139) defines `Archive_path_loaded` with an internal `path_hierarchy` dict and `complete` flag — a stateful signal that lets newly created widgets "catch up" on already-published events. This is not standard Textual signal usage; it is scaffolding for the lazy-loading concurrency model of the browse UI.

- `3e7e787` — "Remove some default system commands that aren't particular useful for this app." (Removes Textual system command entries from `Browse_app.get_system_commands` — lines 46–56 of `app.py` filter out `Screenshot`, `Minimize`, `Maximize`.)

## Taxonomy Summary

| Task Shape | Instances at Cutoff | Key Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Feature** | 5 discrete features | `browse` TUI action; `archive_hostname`/`archive_username`; `--quick-stats` on prune; MariaDB dump options; credential subsystem |
| **Localized Bug Fix** | ~11 targeted fixes | `compact` threshold=0; `compact --progress`; `diff` exclude options; `repo-create` log suppression; ZFS unmount path; `restore` port matching; browse race conditions |
| **Refactor** | 4 | `panels.py` split; function merge; cross-thread → signals; `normalize_commands` extraction |
| **Test Generation** | ~10 commits | Browse test burst driven by 100% coverage enforcement |
| **Dependency Migration** | 2 | Textual/binaryornot adoption (feature-coupled); routine dependency bump |
| **Documentation / Configuration** | ~7 commits | Docs, NEWS, sample systemd service, schema example correction |
| **Boilerplate** | Multiple `__init__.py` | Package markers accompanying feature work |
| **Architectural Scaffolding** | 3 | `Logs_suppressed` infrastructure; credential dispatch plugin system; stateful Textual signal model |
| **Cleanup** | 3 | System command removal; Ruff config; NEWS reorder |

---

## Taxonomy Refinement Proposal

The existing eight categories cover all observed work. One refinement is warranted:

**`feature-coupled dependency migration`** should be distinguished from **`maintenance dependency migration`**. In this codebase, Textual adoption is inseparable from the `browse` feature — the dependency and the feature were introduced together. Treating it as a standalone "dependency migration" obscures that the task shape is actually a feature with a dependency side-effect. The proposed frozen refinement:

> Split **dependency migration** into:
> - `dependency migration (maintenance)` — version bumps and in-place library swaps in existing code (e.g., `b1f42eb`)
> - `dependency migration (feature-coupled)` — new library adoption that only exists to support a simultaneously introduced feature (e.g., Textual for `browse`); should be co-labeled with its parent feature task

No new top-level category is required.
